title: When the Room Burns
author: Rafael Marchetti
blurb: Marguerite Joubert, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
